spec.name: Orange Kitchen Grilled Sausage
spec.description: A glossy chestnut-brown grilled sausage with caramelized golden highlights, three diagonal char marks and small tied ends. Preserves the source stepped silhouette and UV layout, with its length compressed to fit x=0..16. Grounded at y=0, with no bun or plate.

prompt: Refine the existing sausage into the COOKED griddle ingredient used in hot dogs. Keep its long stepped round sausage shape and small tied ends, but replace the pale raw pink casing with glossy toasted chestnut brown, caramelized golden highlights and three diagonal near-black grill marks. Add a restrained shallow split in the browned casing if useful. It must read as appetizing grilled sausage, distinct from raw pork. Standalone sausage, no bun or plate, bottom y0, within x0..16 y0..7 z0..16. Use the existing generated model as a starting point. One well-mapped 64x64 atlas, cohesive Minecraft vanilla pixel art, no text or noise.
